messages.content: I need help finishing a disaster recovery setup.
Happy to help with a disaster recovery setup.
What changed?
Remote state in S3 with DynamoDB locking is no longer on my plate.
Recap please.
The error budget is fine this month. terraform/outputs.tf got a few more lines. Root of the pain: an apply failing on an IAM eventual consistency delay.
Carry on.

After a couple of tries, a module for the standard service deployment finally works. Decisions like this usually need a design doc. Turns out the flakiness was an S3 bucket name collision across accounts.
Anything broken?
IAM roles scoped per service is no longer on my plate.
What changed?
Someone should pick up policy-as-code checks in the plan stage. Retries only apply to failed jobs. That leaves encrypted EBS volumes across all instances behind us.
Personally OIDC for CI authentication into AWS feels right to me.
After a couple of tries, the VPC with public and private subnets across three zones finally works. Turned out .github/workflows/plan.yml was the culprit file. Sure thing.
What changed?
Between the options, Checkov for policy scanning came out ahead. Most of the afternoon went into terraform/variables.tf. Provider versions pinned to a minor range is the clear winner here.
Carry on.
CloudWatch alarms on the error rate metric is no longer on my plate. We landed on Aurora Postgres over standard RDS.
Blockers?
No regressions so far. Turned out terraform/iam.tf was the culprit file.
